title: Resume an open calendar after being idle
steps: Inspect Calendar and Message Center in a single signed-in browser tab. The reproduction environment uses a 5-second idle timeout.
Leave the page open without interacting, let the session expire naturally, and wait for two normal reminder polling cycles.
Return to the calendar. If Week is still available, try switching to the week view.
If a sign-in option appears, submit valid credentials and confirm that the calendar is restored.

video_guide.summary: After the wait, the page shows a sign-in form. Submitting credentials and closing the registration dialog restores the calendar day view.

chapters.note: The page shows the calendar day view, the Administrator time column, and the Message Center tab.

chapters.label: Leave the calendar page open and return after the wait.

chapters.note: The page still shows the calendar day view.
The page shows a sign-in form with Username and Password fields and a Login button.

chapters.label: Enter the username and password, then click Login.

chapters.note: The calendar is visible behind the OpenEMR Product Registration dialog.
The registration dialog is closed. The calendar day view, date, Administrator time column, and Day, Week, and Month buttons are visible again.
